column1: # IT and chat Russian, as lemmas with a paradigm class: the corpus lacks these words, and an
# overlay with one form of each made every other form a typo of it (фичу was corrected to фича).
# scripts/expand-paradigms.py writes every form into ru-tech.tsv, which is merged into ru.txt by
# and ru_bg.txt is rebuilt after it. Tiers match ru-everyday.tsv: 155 for work and tech words,
# 135 for chat slang and for every word of three letters or fewer; every other form of a word
# Lowercase letters only, no names of people, no obscene words; no е spelling of a ё word.
# A word that is also a common word's neighbour (мерж and мере, айти and найти, репа and река)
# stays at 135, under it; a form that is another word's (кожу) is left out with !.
